Functional Enrichment of a Model's Features

Source: R/visualizations.R
enrich_features.Rd

Runs over-representation analysis (ORA) on the genes of a survival model: Gene Ontology and KEGG via clusterProfiler, Reactome via ReactomePA. Features are obtained exactly as in plot_umap / plot_heatmap — selected_features() for penalised models and top_features() for importance-based models ("blockForest", "flexynesis") — or supplied directly via features. Gene symbols are mapped to ENTREZ IDs for KEGG and Reactome; GO is queried on the original key type.

Usage

enrich_features(
  mae,
  model,
  modality = NULL,
  top_feat = NULL,
  features = NULL,
  rho = NULL,
  strip_prefix = NULL,
  databases = c("GO", "KEGG", "Reactome"),
  ont = "ALL",
  key_type = "SYMBOL",
  org_db = "org.Hs.eg.db",
  kegg_organism = "hsa",
  reactome_organism = "human",
  pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
  qvalue_cutoff = 0.2,
  ...
)

Arguments

mae

A MultiAssayExperiment whose metadata()$analysis holds the fitted model (typically the training object).

model

Character string naming the model (e.g. "cox_elastic_net", "blockForest", "flexynesis").

modality

Character string naming the omics modality used to locate a penalised model's selected features (ignored for "blockForest" / "flexynesis"). Default is NULL: the single per-run integration tag ("early_<omics>") is resolved automatically; pass the tag (or an omic name) explicitly to disambiguate.

top_feat

Integer number of top features. Used only for "blockForest" / "flexynesis". If NULL (default), top_features's own default is used.

features

Optional character vector of gene identifiers, overriding the automatic retrieval from model.

rho

Numeric. For model = "AFTCoop" only: selects the beta_rho_<rho> feature set. If NULL (default) and only one rho was trained, it is resolved automatically.

strip_prefix

Optional regular expression removed from the start of each feature name before mapping (e.g. "^(mRNA|meth)_" when assay rows are layer-prefixed). Default is NULL.

databases

Which analyses to run; any of "GO", "KEGG", "Reactome". Default is all three.

ont

GO ontology: "BP", "MF", "CC" or "ALL". Default is "ALL".

key_type

Key type of the input features for GO and ID mapping. Default is "SYMBOL".

org_db

Name of the organism annotation package. Default is "org.Hs.eg.db".

kegg_organism

KEGG organism code. Default is "hsa".

reactome_organism

ReactomePA organism. Default is "human".

pvalue_cutoff, qvalue_cutoff

Significance cut-offs passed to each enrichment call. Defaults are 0.05 and 0.2.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to the enrichment functions.

Value

A named list of enrichResult objects (one per requested database), plus genes (the cleaned input), entrez (the mapped IDs) and universe (the background used, or NULL). KEGG and Reactome results are made readable (ENTREZ back to symbols).

See also

plot_enrichment, selected_features, top_features
